title: Enterprise Web Application Development and Modernization Services
description:
The Army Contracting Command requires enterprise web application development and modernization services. The contractor shall provide full-stack development services including:

1. Modern web application development using React, Next.js, and Node.js
2. Legacy system modernization and migration to cloud-native architectures
3. API development and integration services
4. DevOps implementation and CI/CD pipeline development
5. Microservices architecture design and implementation

The contractor must demonstrate experience with:
- Agile development methodologies
- Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
- Database design and management
- Security best practices and compliance

Period of Performance: Base year plus four option years
Estimated Value: $2.5M - $5M

This is a Small Business Set-Aside. Offerors must be registered in SAM.gov and have an active UEI.

title: AI/Machine Learning Platform Development for Data Analytics
description:
CBP requires development of an AI/Machine Learning platform to support advanced data analytics capabilities. The solution shall include:

- Custom AI model development and training
- Large Language Model (LLM) integration and fine-tuning
- Natural Language Processing capabilities
- Predictive analytics dashboards
- Real-time data processing pipelines
- Python-based backend services
- Modern React frontend for visualization

Technical Requirements:
- Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks
- Cloud-native architecture (preferably AWS GovCloud)
- FedRAMP compliance experience
- Agile/Scrum development methodology
- CI/CD pipeline implementation

Contract Type: Firm Fixed Price
Estimated Value: $1.8M - $3.2M
Period: 12-month base with two 12-month options

title: Cloud Migration and Infrastructure Modernization Support
description:
GSA seeks contractors to provide cloud migration and infrastructure modernization services for multiple federal agencies. Services required include:

1. Assessment and planning for cloud migration
2. AWS/Azure/GCP implementation and configuration
3. Containerization using Docker and Kubernetes
4. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
5. Microservices architecture implementation
6. DevSecOps practices and tooling
7. 24/7 monitoring and support

Qualifications:
- Active cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
- Experience with federal cloud environments
- Understanding of FedRAMP and FISMA requirements
- Demonstrated experience with Unix/Linux systems
- Node.js and Python development capabilities

This is a BPA against IT Schedule 70.
Ceiling: $10M over 5 years
Multiple awards anticipated

title: Salesforce CRM Implementation and Integration Services
description:
The VA requires Salesforce CRM implementation and integration services to modernize veteran services. The contractor shall:

- Implement Salesforce Health Cloud and Service Cloud
- Develop custom Lightning components
- Integrate with existing VA systems via APIs
- Migrate data from legacy CRM systems
- Provide training and change management support
- Develop custom reports and dashboards
- Ensure 508 compliance for all interfaces

Required Experience:
- Salesforce certified developers and administrators
- Healthcare industry CRM implementations
- Experience with VA or federal health agencies preferred
- API integration expertise (REST, SOAP)
- Agile project management

This procurement is set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB).

Estimated Contract Value: $3M - $6M
Period of Performance: 3 years

title: IT Help Desk and Technical Support Services
description:
BLM requires IT help desk and technical support services including:

- Tier 1-3 technical support
- Hardware and software troubleshooting
- Network connectivity support
- User account management
- Software installation and configuration
- Remote desktop support
- Knowledge base maintenance

Note: This opportunity requires primarily on-site support staff and may not be ideal for companies focused on software development.

Requirements:
- ITIL certification preferred
- Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems
- CompTIA A+ or equivalent certifications
- Security+ certification required

This is an 8(a) competitive set-aside.
Contract Value: $500K - $1.2M annually
Period: Base + 4 option years
